rationale: Ezra 1:7 explicitly attributes the earlier removal of the vessels to Nebuchadnezzar; Cyrus is returning them. The other options are concise names of other kings. The correct proper name is naturally longer; padding names would not improve the question.

Hebrews 5:6 and 5:10 explicitly name the order of Melchisedec. Aaron, Zadok, and Eleazar are concise competing priestly names. The flag reflects the length of the proper name; adding titles or unrelated detail would introduce padding and different grammatical forms.

1 Corinthians 13:13 names faith, hope, charity and explicitly says the greatest is charity. Naming all compared virtues in the prompt does not identify the greatest; the question still requires the comparison. The false not-compared option is contradicted by the verse.
